summary: Both blocking findings are valid and should be repaired with small spec changes: enumerate the primary measurement sample directories and define the minimum migration parity public-surface inventory.

items.title: Primary measurement sample is ambiguous
items.rationale: The finding is blocking because the repository has two spec directories with numeric prefix 299, and tests for measurement coverage need a deterministic sample set.
items.evidence: `find specs -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '29[3-9]-*'` returned specs/293-bounded-defer-review, specs/294-setup-preset-options, specs/295-producer-artifact-contract, specs/296-review-gate-defer, specs/297-setup-official-presets, specs/298-fix-presets-list-tree, specs/299-agent-config-setup, and specs/299-worktree-config-preflight.

items.title: Migration parity coverage has no fixed inventory source
items.rationale: The finding is blocking because migration parity tests cannot determine completeness unless the retained public surfaces are explicitly enumerated in spec.json.
items.evidence: Draft knownFacts inventory names flow skill dispatch, next-action envelope, review phases, impl review, gate, context.search, auto-check, finalize-sync, docs build, AI JSON repair, and flow findings / issue-log / acceptance evidence artifacts.
